learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how working together as a team makes hard tasks easy and fun!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we do things alone it might take a long time. But when we work together with our friends we can finish big tasks very quickly!
In our story we see that helping each other solves big problems. Just like many tiny drops of water make a big ocean many small hands can do great things.
Always be ready to help others and share your things. A good team always listens to each other and smiles together.

fun_activity.title: 🎈 The Balloon Bounce Game
fun_activity.instructions: Hold hands with two friends and try to keep a balloon in the air without letting it touch the ground. You have to move as a team!

quick_recap: ⭐ Teamwork makes hard jobs simple and fun.
⭐ We should always help our friends and family.
